summary: KIKUT SENTRUM AS (org. no. 991 372 741) is a private limited company (AS) based in Hol, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2007-06-18. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.110 (Kjøp og salg av egen fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was NOK 15 116. Board chair: Arne Pålgardhaugen; auditor: ERNST & YOUNG AS.
